500.d: Elale or Elaleh, a place east of the Jordan
500.r: or (more properly) אֶלְעָלֵה; from H410 (אֵל) and H5927 (עָלָה); God (is) going up;

501.d: Elasah, the name of four Israelites
501.r: from H410 (אֵל) and H6213 (עָשָׂה); God has made;

502.d: hence, to learn (and causatively to teach)
502.r: a primitive root, to associate with;

504.d: a family; also (from the sense of yoking or taming) an ox or cow

505.d: hence (the ox's head being the first letter of the alphabet, and this eventually used as a numeral) a thousand

506.d: {hence (the ox's head being the first letter of the alphabet, and this eventually used as a numeral) a thousand}

508.r: from H410 (אֵל) and H6466 (פָּעַל); God (is) act;

511.d: Elkanah, the name of several Israelites
511.r: from H410 (אֵל) and H7069 (קָנָה); God has obtained;

512.d: an Elkoshite or native of Elkosh
512.r: patrial from a name of uncertain derivation;

513.r: probably from H410 (אֵל) and a masculine form of H8435 (תּוֹלְדָה) (compare H8434 (תּוֹלָד)); God (is) generator;

514.d: Eltekeh or Elteke, a place in Palestine
514.r: or (more properly) אֶלְתְּקֵה; of uncertain derivation;

515.r: from H410 (אֵל) and H8626 (תָּקַן); God (is) straight;

516.d: 'Thou must not destroy'; probably the opening words to a popular song

517.d: a mother (as the bond of the family); in a wide sense (both literally and figuratively (like father))

518.d: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!; interrogative, whether?; or conditional, if, although; also Oh that!, when; hence, as a negative, not
518.k: (and, can-, doubtless, if, that) (not), [phrase] but, either, [phrase] except, [phrase] more(-over if, than), neither, nevertheless, nor, oh that, or, [phrase] save (only, -ing), seeing, since, sith, [phrase] surely (no more, none, not), though, [phrase] of a truth, [phrase] unless, [phrase] verily, when, whereas, whether, while, [phrase] yet.

520.d: properly, a mother (i.e. unit of measure, or the fore-arm (below the elbow), i.e. a cubit; also a door-base (as a bond of the entrance)
520.k: cubit, [phrase] hundred (by exchange for H3967 (מֵאָה)), measure, post.

521.d: {properly, a mother (i.e. unit of measure, or the fore-arm (below the elbow), i.e. a cubit; also a door-base (as a bond of the entrance)}

523.d: a collection, i.e. community of persons

525.r: from H539 (אָמַן), probably in the sense of training; like H542 (אָמָן)

526.d: Amon, the name of three Israelites

528.d: Amon (i.e. Ammon or Amn), a deity of Egypt
528.r: of Egyptian derivation; used only as an adjunct of H4996 (נֹא)

530.d: literally firmness; figuratively security; morally fidelity
530.k: faith(-ful, -ly, -ness, (man)), set office, stability, steady, truly, truth, verily.

534.d: a summit (of a tree or mountain)
534.r: apparently from H559 (אָמַר) (in the sense of self-exaltation);

535.d: to droop; by implication to be sick, to mourn

539.d: properly, to build up or support; to foster as a parent or nurse; figuratively to render (or be) firm or faithful, to trust or believe, to be permanent or quiet; morally to be true or certain;
539.r: a primitive root; (Isaiah 30:21; interchangeable with H541 (אָמַן), to go to the right hand)
539.k: hence, assurance, believe, bring up, establish, [phrase] fail, be faithful (of long continuance, stedfast, sure, surely, trusty, verified), nurse, (-ing father), (put), trust, turn to the right.

540.d: {properly, to build up or support; to foster as a parent or nurse; figuratively to render (or be) firm or faithful, to trust or believe, to be permanent or quiet; morally to be true or certain};

541.d: to take the right hand road
541.k: turn to the right. See H539 (אָמַן).

542.r: from H539 (אָמַן) (in the sense of training);

545.r: feminine of H544 (אֹמֶן) (in the specific sense of training);

546.r: feminine form of H544 (אֹמֶן) (in its usual sense);

547.r: feminine active participle of H544 (אֹמֶן) (in the original sense of supporting);

548.d: something fixed, i.e. a covenant. an allowance

550.d: Amnon (or Aminon), a son of David

551.k: indeed, no doubt, surely, (it is, of a) true(-ly, -th).

553.d: to be alert, physically (on foot) or mentally (in courage)
553.k: confirm, be courageous (of good courage, stedfastly minded, strong, stronger), establish, fortify, harden, increase, prevail, strengthen (self), make strong (obstinate, speed).

554.d: of a strong color, i.e. red (others fleet)

558.d: Amatsjah, the name of four Israelites
558.r: or אֲמַצְיָהוּ; from H553 (אָמַץ) and H3050 (יָהּ); strength of Jah;

559.k: answer, appoint, avouch, bid, boast self, call, certify, challenge, charge, [phrase] (at the, give) command(-ment), commune, consider, declare, demand, [idiom] desire, determine, [idiom] expressly, [idiom] indeed, [idiom] intend, name, [idiom] plainly, promise, publish, report, require, say, speak (against, of), [idiom] still, [idiom] suppose, talk, tell, term, [idiom] that is, [idiom] think, use (speech), utter, [idiom] verily, [idiom] yet.

561.k: answer, [idiom] appointed unto him, saying, speech, word.

563.r: (Aramaic) perhaps from H560 (אֲמַר) (in the sense of bringing forth);

564.d: Immer, the name of five Israelites

565.r: or אֶמְרָה; feminine of H561 (אֵמֶר), and meaning the same

566.d: Imri, the name of two Israelites

567.d: an Emorite, one of the Canaanitish tribes
567.r: probably a patronymic from an unused name derived from H559 (אָמַר) in the sense of publicity, i.e. prominence; thus, a mountaineer;

568.d: Amarjah, the name of nine Israelites
568.r: or prolonged אֲמַרְיָהוּ; from H559 (אָמַר) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has said (i.e. promised);

571.k: assured(-ly), establishment, faithful, right, sure, true (-ly, -th), verity.

572.d: properly, something expansive, i.e. a bag

574.r: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to that of H4975 (מֹתֶן);

575.d: where?; hence, whither?, when?; also hither and thither

576.r: (Aramaic) or אֲנָה; (Aramaic), corresponding to H589 (אֲנִי)lemma אֲנַי second vowel, corrected to אֲנִי;

577.r: or אָנָּה; apparent contracted from H160 (אַהֲבָה) and H4994 (נָא);

579.d: to approach; hence, to meet in various senses
579.r: a primitive root (perhaps rather identical with H578 (אָנָה) through the idea of contraction in anguish);
579.k: befall, deliver, happen, seek a quarrel.

581.r: (Aramaic) or (feminine) אִנִּיןlemma אֵנִּין first vowel, corrected to אִנִּין; (Aramaic), corresponding to H1992 (הֵם);

582.d: a man in general (singly or collectively)
582.r: from H605 (אָנַשׁ); properly, a mortal (and thus differing from the more dignified H120 (אָדָם)); hence,
582.k: another, [idiom] (blood-) thirsty, certain, chap(-man); divers, fellow, [idiom] in the flower of their age, husband, (certain, mortal) man, people, person, servant, some ([idiom] of them), [phrase] stranger, those, [phrase] their trade. It is often unexpressed in the English versions, especially when used in apposition with another word. Compare H376 (אִישׁ).

588.r: probably from the same root as H5170 (נַחַר); a gorge or narrow pass;

589.k: I, (as for) me, mine, myself, we, [idiom] which, [idiom] who.

590.r: probably from H579 (אָנָה) (in the sense of conveyance);

593.r: from H578 (אָנָה) and H5971 (עַם); groaning of (the) people;

594.d: according to most a plumb-line, and to others a hook
594.r: probably from an unused root meaning to be narrow;

599.d: to breathe hard, i.e. be enraged
